title: There is another way but I won’t tell you what it is.
html_source:
Joyce insisted that there were several unprintable variations of this riddle:

In what town can one enjoy a woman best?

– In Athy (a thigh), for that’s near the middle of the Queen’s County.

Yeah…her “county”…
